# unifi_protect_camera (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi Protect camera by `mac` or `id` (read-only). Use it to reference a camera that Terraform does not manage (e.g. as the target of a liveview).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Protect object id. Provide `id` or `mac`.
- `mac` (String) Camera MAC address. Provide `mac` or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `has_speaker` (Boolean) Whether the camera has a speaker.
- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the camera is adopted.
- `mic_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the microphone is enabled.
- `model` (String) Hardware model / type.
- `name` (String) Camera display name.
- `recording_mode` (String) Current recording mode.
- `state` (String) Connection state.
- `type` (String) Device type identifier.
- `video_mode` (String) Current video mode.
